name: cyclpoly
setup: p74 = cyclpoly(7,4); p1511 = cyclpoly(15,11); pmin = cyclpoly(7,4,'min'); pmax = cyclpoly(7,4,'max'); pall = cyclpoly(7,4,'all'); pall15 = cyclpoly(15,5,'all');
comment: Sig: p = cyclpoly(n,k[,opt]). Generator polynomial(s) of an (n,k) cyclic code: degree-(n-k) polys 1+...+x^(n-k) dividing x^n-1 over GF(2). Ascending powers. cyclpoly(7,4)=[1 0 1 1]; (15,11)=[1 0 0 1 1]. opt: ''=first, 'min'=fewest terms ([1 0 1 1]), 'max'=most terms ([1 1 0 1]), 'all'=every gen poly sorted by term count (7,4 -> [1 0 1 1;1 1 0 1]; 15,5 -> 3 rows). New (Error Correction Codes / block linear codes) 2026-06. GF(2) only.
